ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This section is for Lake County Educator Field Trip participants only. Students may elect to register for 2 or 3 credit hours. Students will complete 2 projects for 2 graduate credits and 3 projects for 3 graduate credits. Students taking this course may repeat it, however, only it will only be accepted one time for the Ag Education M.S. program.
